name: Post Box Bank
description:
Dimensions: Height: 7 inches | Width: 3.5 inches

Bring a nostalgic touch to your space with this miniature red post box coin bank inspired by the iconic postal boxes of Bangladesh. Detailed with "Dhaka-1200" and other realistic accents, this coin bank combines functionality with a vintage vibe. Perfect for saving coins or as a charming display piece for your desk, shelf, or collection.

Features:

Authentic post box design with hand-painted details
Sturdy and durable construction
Convenient coin slot at the top
Compact and lightweight for easy placement
Add this delightful and unique collectible to your home or gift it to a loved one for a memorable keepsake.
